sql: SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities c ON c.id = e.city_id WHERE e.role = 'sales_rep' AND c.name = 'Khamis Mushait' ORDER BY e.name

SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(o.id) >= 10 ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(o.id) DESC, e.name LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) - COALESCE(SUM(rt.refund_amount), 0) AS net_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) = '09' GROUP BY o.employee_id) o ON o.employee_id = e.id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07', '08', '09') GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3
SELECT ci.name FROM customers cu JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = cu.city_id WHERE cu.name = 'Ghamdi Logistics'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND c.segment = 'retail' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND (substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) = '01' OR substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) = '02' OR substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) = '03')

SELECT cu.segment, ROUND(AVG(oi.quantity), 2) AS avg_units FROM customers cu JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = cu.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY cu.segment ORDER BY avg_units DESC, cu.segment LIMIT 1

SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN r.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(oi.id) DESC, month LIMIT 1

SELECT c.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cities WHERE region_id = (SELECT id FROM regions WHERE name = 'Makkah')

SELECT e.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) - COALESCE(SUM(rt.refund_amount), 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM employees e JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07', '08', '09', '10', '11', '12') GROUP BY e.id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, e.name LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM products WHERE category_id = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'Stationery') AND active = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cities WHERE region_id = (SELECT id FROM regions WHERE name = 'Asir')

SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN r.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(oi.id) DESC, month LIMIT 1
SELECT unit_price FROM products WHERE sku = 'SKU-0012'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS n FROM customers c WHERE c.created_at < '2025-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = 'low' AND substr(opened_at, 1, 7) IN ('2024-01', '2024-02', '2024-03', '2024-04', '2024-05', '2024-06')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Household' AND p.active = 1

SELECT ci.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' AND (substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) = '10' OR substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) = '11' OR substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) = '12') GROUP BY ci.id ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC, ci.name LIMIT 1

SELECT c.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07', '08', '09') GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT name FROM (SELECT p.id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - p.cost)) AS margin, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - p.cost)) DESC, p.name) AS rn FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('04', '05', '06') GROUP BY p.id) WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY rn, name

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Eastern Province' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07', '08', '09')
SELECT MAX(unit_price) AS max_price FROM products WHERE category_id = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'Bakery')
SELECT ci.name FROM customers cu JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = cu.city_id WHERE cu.name = 'Mohammed Al-Ghamdi'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments WHERE method = 'wallet' AND substr(paid_at, 1, 4) = '2024' AND substr(paid_at, 6, 2) IN ('01', '02', '03')
SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_at) - julianday(shipped_at)), 2) AS avg_days FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'DHL' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT cu.segment, ROUND(AVG(oi.quantity), 2) AS avg_units FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07', '08', '09') GROUP BY cu.segment ORDER BY avg_units DESC, cu.segment LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NULL AND topic = 'billing'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS n FROM (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, substr(order_date, 1, 4) AS year FROM orders WHERE substr(order_date, 1, 4) IN ('2025', '2026') GROUP BY customer_id, substr(order_date, 1, 4) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT substr(order_date, 1, 4)) >= 2)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS n FROM customers c WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) >= 5 AND (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) FROM support_tickets t WHERE t.customer_id = c.id AND closed_at IS NOT NULL) > (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL)

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Eastern Province' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('01', '02', '03', '04', '05', '06')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cities WHERE region_id = (SELECT id FROM regions WHERE name = 'Qassim')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS n FROM (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, substr(order_date, 1, 4) AS year FROM orders WHERE substr(order_date, 1, 4) IN ('2024', '2026') GROUP BY customer_id, substr(order_date, 1, 4)) GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT year) = 2
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE segment = 'retail'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS n FROM customers c WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) >= 2 AND (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) FROM support_tickets t WHERE t.customer_id = c.id AND closed_at IS NOT NULL) > (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE segment = 'retail'

SELECT c.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) <= '06' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments WHERE method = 'card' AND substr(paid_at, 1, 4) = '2024' AND substr(paid_at, 6, 2) IN ('10', '11', '12')
SELECT MAX(unit_price) AS max_price FROM products WHERE category_id = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'Snacks')
SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities c ON c.id = e.city_id WHERE e.role = 'sales_rep' AND c.name = 'Dubai' ORDER BY e.name

SELECT o.channel FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('10', '11', '12') GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY AVG(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) DESC, o.channel LIMIT 1

SELECT name FROM (SELECT r.name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2024-06' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-06' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2025, (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-06' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2024-06' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2024-06' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS growth FROM regions r JOIN cities ci ON ci.region_id = r.id JOIN customers c ON c.city_id = ci.id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY r.id) ORDER BY growth, name LIMIT 1

SELECT r.name FROM (SELECT r.id, r.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue, substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) AS year FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND (substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2024-06' OR substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-06') GROUP BY r.id, r.name, substr(o.order_date, 1, 4)) GROUP BY r.id, r.name ORDER BY (MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2025' THEN revenue ELSE NULL END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2024' THEN revenue ELSE NULL END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2024' THEN revenue ELSE NULL END) DESC, r.name LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE segment = 'enterprise'

SELECT p.name FROM (SELECT p.id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - p.cost)) AS margin, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - p.cost)) DESC, p.name) AS rn FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07', '08', '09') GROUP BY p.id, p.name) WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY rn, p.name
